messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "spasm of blood vessels in the brain"
set: ["spasm of blood vessels in the brain", "blood vessels", "beta-2 receptors in the airways and blood vessels", "relaxing and widening the blood vessels", "bleeding in the brain", "chemicals in the brain", "blocking the reabsorption of serotonin in the brain", "restoring balance of serotonin in the brain", "nerve signals in the brain", "natural substances in the brain", "changing levels of certain chemicals in the brain", "decreasing certain chemicals that tighten the blood vessels", "protects heart and blood vessels", "chemicals in the brain and nerves", "reducing nerve signals in the brain", "increasing serotonin activity in the brain"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
